s.t: A queen lived in a kingdom with her daughter.
s.fr: Une reine vivait dans un royaume avec sa fille.

s.t: The princess had golden hair.
s.fr: La princesse avait les cheveux dorés.

s.t: The princess was kind and wise.
s.fr: La princesse était gentille et sage.

s.t: The queen had a horse named Falada.
s.fr: La reine avait un cheval nommé Falada.

s.t: Falada spoke like a person.
s.fr: Falada parlait comme une personne.

s.t: Only the queen and the princess knew this.
s.fr: Seulement la reine et la princesse savaient cela.

s.t: The queen taught her a wind charm.
s.fr: La reine lui apprit un charme du vent.

paras.summary: A queen and her daughter, a princess with golden hair who is kind and wise, live in a kingdom, and the queen has a horse named Falada who can talk, though only she and the princess know it; the queen also teaches her a charm for the wind.

s.t: Far away, a prince lived in another kingdom.
s.fr: Loin, un prince vivait dans un autre royaume.

s.t: The princess would marry him.
s.fr: La princesse l’épouserait.

s.t: "Ride to his castle," the queen said.
s.fr: « Chevauchez jusqu’à son château, » dit la reine.

s.t: The queen told a maid to ride with her.
s.fr: La reine dit à une servante de chevaucher avec elle.

s.t: She rode away from the queen.
s.fr: Elle s’éloigna de la reine.

paras.summary: Far away, a prince lives in another kingdom, and the princess will marry him, so the queen tells her to ride to his castle and picks a maid to go with her, and the princess feels glad but a little afraid as she rides away from the queen.

s.t: The princess rode Falada down the road toward the castle.
s.fr: La princesse chevaucha Falada sur la route vers le château.

s.t: The maid rode another horse near her.
s.fr: La servante chevaucha un autre cheval près d’elle.

s.t: They would ride for days.
s.fr: Ils chevaucheraient pendant des jours.

s.t: The maid was proud.
s.fr: La servante était fière.

paras.summary: The princess and the maid ride out together, Falada and another horse carrying them for a journey of days, and the maid is proud.

s.t: The princess missed the queen.
s.fr: La princesse regrettait la reine.

s.t: But she wanted to see the prince.
s.fr: Mais elle voulait voir le prince.

s.t: Falada spoke to the princess.
s.fr: Falada parla à la princesse.

s.t: "I will help you," Falada said.
s.fr: « Je t’aiderai, » dit Falada.

s.t: The princess smiled.
s.fr: La princesse sourit.

s.t: The maid overheard and knew Falada's secret.
s.fr: La servante entendit cela et connut le secret de Falada.

paras.summary: The princess misses the queen but wants to see the prince, though the prince's kingdom is far away; Falada speaks to the princess, promising to help her, and she smiles, but the maid overhears and now knows Falada's secret.

s.t: One day, on the road, the princess was thirsty.
s.fr: Un jour, sur la route, la princesse avait soif.

s.t: She saw a stream near the road.
s.fr: Elle vit un ruisseau près de la route.

s.t: "Please bring me water," she said to the maid.
s.fr: « S’il vous plaît, apportez-moi de l’eau, » dit-elle à la servante.

s.t: "I will not serve you anymore," said the maid.
s.fr: « Je ne vous servirai plus, » dit la servante.

s.t: The princess was surprised.
s.fr: La princesse fut surprise.

paras.summary: One day the princess grows thirsty and asks the maid to bring her water, but the maid refuses to serve her anymore, surprising the princess.

s.t: She walked to the stream herself.
s.fr: Elle marcha elle-même jusqu’au ruisseau.

s.t: She bent down and drank the water.
s.fr: Elle se pencha et but l’eau.

s.t: The maid watched her and smiled to herself.
s.fr: La servante la regarda et sourit en elle-même.

s.t: The princess said nothing.
s.fr: La princesse ne dit rien.

s.t: They rode on toward the prince's castle.
s.fr: Elles chevauchèrent vers le château du prince.

paras.summary: The princess walks to the stream and drinks the water herself while the maid watches and smiles to herself, and the princess says nothing as they ride on toward the prince's castle.

s.t: The next day, on the road, the princess was thirsty again.
s.fr: Le lendemain, sur la route, la princesse avait de nouveau soif.

s.t: "Please bring me water," she said again.
s.fr: « S’il vous plaît, apportez-moi de l’eau, » dit-elle de nouveau.

s.t: "Get the water yourself," said the maid.
s.fr: « Allez chercher l’eau vous-même, » dit la servante.

s.t: The princess said nothing and bent down to drink.
s.fr: La princesse ne dit rien et se pencha pour boire.

s.t: The maid saw this and was not afraid.
s.fr: La servante vit cela et n’eut pas peur.

s.t: "Get down from Falada," said the maid.
s.fr: « Descendez de Falada, » dit la servante.

s.t: "I will take your clothes," she said.
s.fr: « Je prendrai vos vêtements, » dit-elle.

paras.summary: The next day the princess is thirsty again and asks the maid for water, but the maid refuses and tells her to get it herself, and seeing that the princess will not fight back, the maid is no longer afraid to demand she get off Falada and hand over her clothes.

s.t: The princess was afraid and obeyed her.
s.fr: La princesse eut peur et lui obéit.

s.t: "Swear to me you will tell no person," said the maid.
s.fr: « Jurez-moi que vous ne le direz à personne, » dit la servante.

s.t: "If you tell, you will die," she said.
s.fr: « Si vous le dites, vous mourrez, » dit-elle.

s.t: The princess swore the oath.
s.fr: La princesse jura le serment.

s.t: They changed clothes and horses near the stream.
s.fr: Elles changèrent de vêtements et de chevaux près du ruisseau.

s.t: The maid rode Falada in the princess's clothes.
s.fr: La servante monta Falada avec les vêtements de la princesse.

s.t: The princess rode the maid's old horse instead.
s.fr: La princesse monta le vieux cheval de la servante à la place.

paras.summary: Afraid, the princess obeys, and the maid makes her swear to tell no person what happened, or die, so the princess swears the oath, and the two change clothes and horses by the stream, with the maid now wearing the princess's clothes and riding Falada while the princess rides the maid's old horse instead.

s.t: The bride rode Falada to the old king's castle.
s.fr: La mariée chevaucha Falada jusqu’au château du vieux roi.

s.t: He came to see her.
s.fr: Il vint la voir.

s.t: The prince took her hand and smiled.
s.fr: Le prince prit sa main et sourit.

s.t: "You are beautiful," he said.
s.fr: « Vous êtes belle, » dit-il.

s.t: The king was glad for his son.
s.fr: Le roi était content pour son fils.

paras.summary: The bride rides Falada to the old king's castle, where he comes to greet her, and the prince takes her hand and smiles, calling her beautiful, so the king is glad for his son.

s.t: He planned a wedding feast.
s.fr: Il organisa un festin de noces.

s.t: Servants helped with the feast.
s.fr: Des serviteurs aidèrent pour le festin.

s.t: The bride smiled at everyone.
s.fr: La mariée sourit à tout le monde.

s.t: She was glad about her plan.
s.fr: Elle était contente de son plan.

s.t: No one at the old castle knew her secret.
s.fr: Personne au vieux château ne connaissait son secret.

s.t: Falada watched the bride and said nothing.
s.fr: Falada observa la mariée et ne dit rien.

paras.summary: He plans a wedding feast, and servants help with it, and the bride smiles at everyone, glad about her plan, for no one at the castle knows her secret, though Falada watches the bride and says nothing.

s.t: The girl stood near the castle gate.
s.fr: La fille se tint près de la porte du château.

s.t: No one looked at her.
s.fr: Personne ne la regarda.

s.t: Everyone at the castle looked at the bride instead.
s.fr: Tout le monde au château regarda la mariée à la place.

s.t: The old king saw the girl.
s.fr: Le vieux roi vit la fille.

s.t: "Who is this girl?" he asked the bride.
s.fr: « Qui est cette fille ? » demanda-t-il à la mariée.

paras.summary: The girl stands near the castle gate, unnoticed as everyone looks at the bride instead, until the old king sees her and asks the bride who this girl is.

s.t: "She can tend the geese," said the bride.
s.fr: « Elle peut garder les oies, » dit la mariée.

s.t: He agreed.
s.fr: Il accepta.

s.t: A goose boy watched the king's geese in a field.
s.fr: Un garçon aux oies surveilla les oies du roi dans un champ.

s.t: "You will help him," the king told the girl.
s.fr: « Tu l’aideras, » dit le roi à la fille.

s.t: The girl said nothing and obeyed.
s.fr: La fille ne dit rien et obéit.

paras.summary: The bride carelessly says the girl can tend the geese, and the king agrees, and since a goose boy already watches the king's geese, he tells the girl to help him, and she says nothing and obeys.

s.t: Falada had seen the clothes and horses change.
s.fr: Falada avait vu les vêtements et les chevaux changer.

s.t: The bride knew that Falada spoke.
s.fr: La mariée savait que Falada parlait.

s.t: The bride was afraid that Falada would tell the truth.
s.fr: La mariée avait peur que Falada dise la vérité.

s.t: She told the old king that Falada should die.
s.fr: Elle dit au vieux roi que Falada devait mourir.

s.t: The old king agreed and knew nothing about the secret.
s.fr: Le vieux roi accepta et ne sut rien du secret.

s.t: Servants took Falada away, and his head was cut.
s.fr: Les serviteurs emmenèrent Falada, et sa tête fut coupée.

paras.summary: Falada had seen the princess and the maid change clothes and horses, and the bride knows that Falada speaks and is afraid he will tell the truth, so she tells the old king that Falada should die, and the king agrees, knowing nothing about the secret, so servants take Falada away and his head is cut.

s.t: The goose girl said nothing, but she had a plan.
s.fr: La fille aux oies ne dit rien, mais elle avait un plan.

s.t: "Please nail Falada's head over the town gate," she said.
s.fr: « Clouez la tête de Falada au-dessus de la porte de la ville, s’il vous plaît, » dit-elle.

s.t: "I pass here with the geese every morning," she told him.
s.fr: « Je passe ici avec les oies chaque matin, » lui dit-elle.

s.t: The servant agreed to help her.
s.fr: Le serviteur accepta de l’aider.

paras.summary: The goose girl says nothing but has a plan: she asks that Falada's head be nailed over the town gate she passes with the geese every morning, and the servant agrees to help her.

s.t: He nailed the head over the gate that morning.
s.fr: Il cloua la tête au-dessus de la porte ce matin-là.

s.t: No one but the goose girl knew the truth about Falada.
s.fr: Personne d’autre que la fille aux oies ne connaissait la vérité sur Falada.

s.t: Every morning, the goose girl came to the gate with the geese.
s.fr: Chaque matin, la fille aux oies venait à la porte avec les oies.

s.t: She missed Falada and was glad no one knew.
s.fr: Elle regrettait Falada et était contente que personne ne sache.

paras.summary: He nails the head over the gate that morning, so that no one but the goose girl knows the truth about Falada; every morning she comes to the gate with the geese, missing him but glad no one knows.

s.t: Falada's head hung over the gate and spoke to her.
s.fr: La tête de Falada pendait au-dessus de la porte et lui parlait.

s.t: "If the queen knew this, her heart would break," it said.
s.fr: « Si la reine savait cela, son cœur se briserait, » dit-il.

paras.summary: Every morning the goose girl drives the geese past the gate, where Falada's head hangs and speaks to her, saying that if the queen knew this, her heart would break, and the goose girl is sad every morning she hears it.

s.t: She drove the geese to a field outside the town.
s.fr: Elle conduisit les oies dans un champ à l’extérieur de la ville.

s.t: The goose boy waited for her.
s.fr: Le garçon aux oies l’attendait.

s.t: The goose girl had golden hair.
s.fr: La gardienne d’oies avait les cheveux dorés.

s.t: The goose boy wanted to pull it.
s.fr: Le garçon aux oies voulait les tirer.

paras.summary: But she must go on with the geese, driving them to a field outside the town where the goose boy waits for her, and since the goose girl has golden hair, the goose boy wants to pull it.

s.t: The goose girl remembered her wind charm.
s.fr: La gardienne d’oies se souvint de son charme du vent.

s.t: "Blow, wind, blow his hat away," she said.
s.fr: « Souffle, vent, souffle son chapeau au loin, » dit-elle.

s.t: The wind blew and took his hat.
s.fr: Le vent souffla et emporta son chapeau.

s.t: The goose boy ran for his hat.
s.fr: Le garçon aux oies courut chercher son chapeau.

s.t: The goose girl combed her hair in peace.
s.fr: La fille aux oies se peigna les cheveux en paix.

paras.summary: The goose girl remembers her wind charm and calls on the wind to blow his hat away; the wind blows and takes his hat, so the goose boy runs for it while the goose girl combs her hair in peace.

s.t: Every day, the wind blew the goose boy's hat away.
s.fr: Chaque jour, le vent emporta le chapeau du garçon aux oies.

s.t: The goose boy did not like this anymore.
s.fr: Le garçon aux oies n’aimait plus cela.

s.t: He went to the old king.
s.fr: Il alla voir le vieux roi.

s.t: "I do not want to help her anymore," he said.
s.fr: « Je ne veux plus l’aider, » dit-il.

paras.summary: Every day the wind blows the goose boy's hat away, and he does not like it anymore, so he goes to the old king and says he does not want to help her anymore.

s.t: "Why not?" the old king asked.
s.fr: « Pourquoi pas ? » demanda le vieux roi.

s.t: "Odd things happen every morning," said the goose boy.
s.fr: « Des choses étranges arrivent chaque matin, » dit le garçon aux oies.

s.t: "A horse's head speaks at the gate," he said.
s.fr: « Une tête de cheval parle à la porte, » dit-il.

s.t: "The wind blows my hat away," he told him.
s.fr: « Le vent emporte mon chapeau, » lui dit-il.

s.t: The old king was curious about this.
s.fr: Le vieux roi était curieux de cela.

paras.summary: The old king asks why not, and the goose boy says odd things happen every morning: a horse's head speaks at the gate, and the wind blows his hat away, which makes the old king curious.

s.t: "I will come and see," he said.
s.fr: « Je viendrai voir, » dit-il.

s.t: The goose boy smiled and said nothing.
s.fr: Le garçon aux oies sourit et ne dit rien.

s.t: The old king planned to see it all.
s.fr: Le vieux roi planifiait de tout voir.

paras.summary: The old king says he will come and see, and the goose boy smiles and says nothing, while the old king plans to see it all and tells no one about his plan.

s.t: The next morning, the old king rose early.
s.fr: Le lendemain matin, le vieux roi se leva tôt.

s.t: He followed the goose girl to the gate.
s.fr: Il suivit la fille aux oies jusqu’à la porte.

s.t: He hid near the gate and watched her.
s.fr: Il se cacha près de la porte et l’observa.

s.t: "If the queen knew this, her heart would break," it said.
s.fr: « Si la reine savait cela, son cœur se briserait, » dit-il.

s.t: The old king heard this and was surprised.
s.fr: Le vieux roi entendit cela et fut surpris.

s.t: He wondered who this goose girl really was.
s.fr: Il se demanda qui était vraiment cette fille aux oies.

paras.summary: The next morning the old king rises early and follows the goose girl to the gate, where he hides and watches her; Falada's head speaks to her again, saying that if the queen knew this, her heart would break, and the old king hears this, surprised, and wonders who this goose girl really is.

s.t: He followed the goose girl to the field.
s.fr: Il suivit la fille aux oies jusqu’au champ.

s.t: He hid again and watched the geese and the goose boy.
s.fr: Il se cacha encore et observa les oies et le garçon aux oies.

s.t: The goose boy tried to pull the goose girl's hair.
s.fr: Le garçon aux oies essaya de tirer les cheveux de la fille aux oies.

s.t: The goose girl called on the wind again.
s.fr: La fille aux oies fit appel au vent encore.

paras.summary: He follows the goose girl to the field and hides again, watching the geese and the goose boy, who tries to pull the goose girl's hair.

s.t: The wind blew and took the boy's hat.
s.fr: Le vent souffla et emporta le chapeau du garçon.

s.t: He decided to learn the truth.
s.fr: Il décida d’apprendre la vérité.

paras.summary: She calls on the wind again, and it blows and takes the boy's hat, so the old king, who has never seen such a thing, knows the goose boy was right and decides to learn the truth.

s.t: That day, the old king went to the goose girl.
s.fr: Ce jour-là, le vieux roi alla vers la fille aux oies.

s.t: "Tell me who you really are," he said.
s.fr: « Dis-moi qui tu es vraiment, » dit-il.

s.t: The goose girl was afraid to speak.
s.fr: La fille aux oies avait peur de parler.

s.t: "I cannot tell any person," she said.
s.fr: « Je ne peux le dire à personne, » dit-elle.

s.t: "I swore an oath on the road," she told him.
s.fr: « J’ai prêté serment sur la route, » lui dit-elle.

s.t: The old king thought about her words.
s.fr: Le vieux roi réfléchit à ses mots.

paras.summary: That day the old king goes to the goose girl and tells her to say who she really is, but she is afraid to speak, saying she cannot tell any person, for she swore an oath on the road, and the old king thinks about her words.

s.t: He knew she would not tell any living person.
s.fr: Il savait qu’elle ne dirait rien à aucune personne vivante.

s.t: But a stove is not a person.
s.fr: Mais un poêle n’est pas une personne.

s.t: "Tell your story to the iron stove," the old king said.
s.fr: « Raconte ton histoire au poêle de fer, » dit le vieux roi.

s.t: "I will listen at the pipe outside," he said.
s.fr: « J’écouterai au tuyau dehors, » dit-il.

s.t: The goose girl understood the old king's plan.
s.fr: La fille aux oies comprit le plan du vieux roi.

s.t: She agreed to tell the stove her story.
s.fr: Elle accepta de raconter son histoire au poêle.

paras.summary: He knows she cannot tell any living person, but a stove is not a person, so the old king tells her to tell her story to the iron stove while he listens at the pipe outside, and the goose girl, understanding his plan, agrees to tell the stove her story.

s.t: That evening, the goose girl came to the stove room.
s.fr: Ce soir-là, la fille aux oies vint dans la salle du poêle.

s.t: She thought no one was in the room with the stove.
s.fr: Elle pensait que personne n’était dans la salle avec le poêle.

s.t: The old king was outside, near the pipe, and listened.
s.fr: Le vieux roi était dehors, près du tuyau, et écoutait.

s.t: The goose girl told the iron stove all her story.
s.fr: La fille aux oies raconta au poêle de fer toute son histoire.

paras.summary: That evening the goose girl comes to the stove room, thinking no one is there, though the old king is outside near the pipe and listens, and she tells the iron stove her story.

s.t: "I am really a princess," she said to the stove.
s.fr: « Je suis vraiment une princesse, » dit-elle au poêle.

s.t: "A queen was my mother, and Falada was my horse."
s.fr: « Une reine était ma mère, et Falada était mon cheval. »

s.t: "My maid told me to swear an oath on the road."
s.fr: « Ma servante m’a dit de jurer un serment sur la route. »

s.t: "The maid and I changed clothes and horses on the road."
s.fr: « La servante et moi avons échangé nos vêtements et nos chevaux sur la route. »

paras.summary: She says she is really a princess, whose mother was a queen and whose horse was Falada, but her maid told her to swear an oath on the road, where they changed clothes and horses.

s.t: "She is the bride, and I am the goose girl."
s.fr: « Elle est la mariée, et moi je suis la fille aux oies. »

s.t: "The bride had Falada's head cut."
s.fr: « La mariée a fait couper la tête de Falada. »

s.t: "I asked for his head over the gate."
s.fr: « J’ai demandé sa tête au-dessus de la porte. »

s.t: "His head speaks to me at the gate every morning," she said.
s.fr: « Sa tête me parle à la porte chaque matin, » dit-elle.

s.t: The old king listened to every word.
s.fr: Le vieux roi écouta chaque mot.

paras.summary: She says the maid is the bride while she is the goose girl, that the bride had Falada's head cut, and that she asked for his head over the gate, where it speaks to her every morning, and the old king listens to every word.

s.t: The next morning, the old king came to the goose girl.
s.fr: Le lendemain matin, le vieux roi vint voir la fille aux oies.

s.t: "I heard your story last night," he said.
s.fr: « J’ai entendu votre histoire hier soir, » dit-il.

s.t: "I know you are the true princess," he said.
s.fr: « Je sais que vous êtes la vraie princesse, » dit-il.

s.t: The goose girl was surprised that he knew.
s.fr: La fille aux oies fut surprise qu’il le sache.

s.t: "You do not have to hide anymore," said the old king.
s.fr: « Vous n’avez plus besoin de vous cacher, » dit le vieux roi.

s.t: The old king had royal clothes brought for her.
s.fr: Le vieux roi fit apporter des vêtements royaux pour elle.

paras.summary: The next morning the old king comes to the goose girl and says he heard her story last night and knows she is the true princess, so she is surprised, but he tells her she no longer has to hide and has royal clothes brought for her.

s.t: She wore clothes like a true princess.
s.fr: Elle portait des vêtements comme une vraie princesse.

s.t: Her golden hair shone in the morning sun.
s.fr: Ses cheveux dorés brillaient dans le soleil du matin.

s.t: The goose girl looked like a true princess again.
s.fr: La fille aux oies ressemblait de nouveau à une vraie princesse.

paras.summary: She wears clothes like a true princess, her golden hair shining in the morning sun, so that the goose girl looks like a true princess again, and the old king smiles at her.

s.t: "Come with me to the court," he said.
s.fr: « Venez avec moi à la cour, » dit-il.

s.t: The old king led her to the prince.
s.fr: Le vieux roi la conduisit jusqu’au prince.

s.t: The prince looked at her golden hair with wonder.
s.fr: Le prince regarda ses cheveux dorés avec émerveillement.

s.t: "She is the true princess," said the old king.
s.fr: « C’est la vraie princesse, » dit le vieux roi.

paras.summary: He asks her to come with him to the court and leads her to the prince, who looks at her golden hair with wonder, and the old king tells him she is the true princess.

s.t: That night, there was a feast at the castle.
s.fr: Cette nuit-là, il y avait un festin au château.

s.t: The true princess sat near the prince.
s.fr: La vraie princesse s’assit près du prince.

s.t: The bride did not know the true princess sat there.
s.fr: La mariée ne savait pas que la vraie princesse était assise là.

s.t: The old king wanted to ask the bride a question.
s.fr: Le vieux roi voulait poser une question à la mariée.

paras.summary: That night there is a feast at the castle, and the true princess sits near the prince, though the bride does not know who the royal lady is, so the old king wants to ask the bride a question.

s.t: "A maid tricked a good princess," the old king said.
s.fr: « Une servante a trompé une bonne princesse, » dit le vieux roi.

s.t: "The maid made the princess swear a false oath," he said.
s.fr: « La servante a forcé la princesse à jurer un faux serment, » dit-il.

s.t: "What should happen to a maid like this?" he asked.
s.fr: « Que devrait-il arriver à une servante comme celle-ci ? » demanda-t-il.

s.t: The bride did not know he meant her.
s.fr: La mariée ne savait pas qu’il parlait d’elle.

s.t: "She should be sent away forever," said the bride.
s.fr: « Elle devrait être renvoyée pour toujours, » dit la mariée.

paras.summary: He tells her a maid tricked a good princess and made her swear a false oath, asking what should happen to a maid like this, though the bride does not know he means her, and she says such a maid should be sent away forever.

s.t: "You have chosen your own fate," said the old king.
s.fr: « Vous avez choisi votre propre destin, » dit le vieux roi.

s.t: "You are the maid, and here is the true princess," he said.
s.fr: « Vous êtes la servante, et voici la vraie princesse, » dit-il.

s.t: The bride was shocked to see the princess.
s.fr: La mariée fut choquée de voir la princesse.

s.t: The old king sent the bride away forever.
s.fr: Le vieux roi renvoya la mariée pour toujours.

s.t: The false bride never returned to the castle.
s.fr: La fausse mariée ne revint jamais au château.

paras.summary: The old king tells her she has chosen her own fate, for she is the maid, and here is the true princess; the bride is shocked to see the princess, and the old king sends her away forever, so the false bride never returns to the castle.

s.t: Soon the true princess married the prince.
s.fr: Bientôt la vraie princesse épousa le prince.

s.t: The wedding was at the old king's castle.
s.fr: Le mariage eut lieu au vieux château du roi.

s.t: The queen came from her own kingdom to see it.
s.fr: La reine vint de son propre royaume pour le voir.

paras.summary: Soon the true princess marries the prince, and the wedding is at the old king's castle, where the queen comes from her own kingdom to see it.

s.t: The goose boy came to the wedding too.
s.fr: Le garçon aux oies vint aussi au mariage.

s.t: The true princess wore golden clothes.
s.fr: La vraie princesse portait des vêtements dorés.

s.t: The prince took her hand and smiled.
s.fr: Le prince prit sa main et sourit.

paras.summary: The goose boy comes to the wedding too; the true princess wears golden clothes, and the prince takes her hand and smiles.

s.t: Falada was gone, but the princess remembered him.
s.fr: Falada était parti, mais la princesse se souvenait de lui.

s.t: The people loved their new princess.
s.fr: Le peuple aimait sa nouvelle princesse.

paras.summary: Falada is gone, but the princess remembers him, and the people love their new princess.
